pages.title: Still Powered?
pages.text: After accidentally kicking a cable loose, I found that equipment which should have lost power was somehow still operating... That should be impossible. The only suspect is this crystal.$(br2)Purifying it again with a modifier somehow allows certain machines to become targets for energy transmission. Yet the machines show none of the same resonance observed in the crystals... Why?

pages.title: Controlling It
pages.text: First use the Binder to connect the wireless crystal to the network, then select the crystal and use it on the target equipment. The two do not need to touch.$(br2)Sneak-use the crystal empty-handed to switch direction: $(bold)Input$() draws energy from the target equipment, while $(bold)Output$() sends energy to it.
This crystal appears capable of further refinement. The required materials are...$(br2)(The remainder of the page is badly damaged.)
